data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1274 recorded adverse prior-year reserve development, with a net deterioration explicitly stated at $13.653m, driven primarily by strengthening on older years (notably 2018 and prior) in Professional Indemnity, Management & Transactional Liability, Contractors liability and Hull classes. The movement was influenced by adverse claims development and by natural catastrophe activity (Hurricane Ida, Windstorm Uri and the German Floods) together with prior-year COVID-19 impacts. The reserve changes contributed to an increase in the combined ratio and an overall strengthening of prior year reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (GROSS insurance liabilities) was not stated explicitly in the notes. The only explicit quantified prior-year movement found is a net deterioration of $13,653,294 (note 5) and this NET figure has been used as a last-resort proxy for prior_year_development_gbp_m. A gross claims development triangle exists (pages 34-35) but extraction/diagonal-sum was not performed here due to table layout complexity and presence of an 'X & prior' column; user may compute a gross PYD from the triangle if needed. All monetary amounts are reported in the native currency (USD) and converted from $000 to millions.
